_help.overlay_name: Text: output PNG name, without the extension. Saved next to this JSON file.
_help.line_length_inches: Positive number: length of all horizontal lines. No shoulder positions are used.
_help.heights_from_back_inches: Nonempty object: quoted level label followed by a nonnegative height in inches. Use a decimal point, not a comma.

_help.colors: Lists of 4 integers from 0 to 255: red, green, blue, opacity. Opacity 0 = transparent; 255 = opaque.
_help.dimensions: Margins: nonnegative integers in pixels. Line width: integer >= 1. Offsets: signed integers in pixels.
_help.show_back_reference: JSON boolean: true or false. Adds a horizontal reference line at y = 0.
_help.back_label: Text displayed below the back reference.
_help.font: file: null for the built-in font, or a TTF path relative to this JSON. size_px: integer >= 1.
_help.labels: show_values: true or false. label_format: text containing {name} and/or {height}, e.g. {name}  {height:.3f} in.
_help.margins: Increase right_margin_px for long labels. Text outside the image is clipped.
